text: Ethics in AI is becoming a very important topic today. As artificial intelligence systems make more decisions in our lives, we must think about bias and fairness. If the data used to train AI is not balanced, the system may treat some groups unfairly. Privacy is another serious concern, because AI often collects and analyses personal information. Companies and governments should also be transparent about how these systems work, so people can trust them. Responsible AI development means thinking about these problems from the beginning, not after something goes wrong. By working together, developers, users and lawmakers can make sure AI helps everyone in a safe and fair way.
